Gap 2 — Grocery Suggest-Swaps (pantry-aware ranking)
Gap 3 — Supplements `skip-today` + inventory auto-decrement
Gap 4 — Nutrition meal-prep routes (5 routes with no dedicated tests)
Gap 5 — Nutrition skip/swap routes (AC-4, AC-5)
Gap 6 — Web components with zero tests
Priority Order
sections.content:
| Priority | Gap | Effort | Risk if Skipped |
|----------|-----|--------|----------------|
| 🔴 P1 | Grocery pantry routes (4 routes, 0 tests) | S | Pantry bugs invisible to CI |
| 🔴 P1 | Supplements `skip-today` + inventory decrement | S | Idempotency and stock logic ship untested |
| 🟠 P2 | Nutrition meal-prep (5 routes, 0 dedicated tests) | M | Complex Gemini + session state untested |
| 🟠 P2 | Nutrition skip/swap/recalculate (AC-4/5/6) | M | Core action-bar flows untested |
| 🟡 P3 | Grocery suggest-swaps ranking | S | Ranking algorithm bugs |
| 🟡 P3 | SetRow / MacroRing component tests | M | UI regressions on core workout/nutrition views |

The biggest real gap is the **grocery pantry routes** and **supplements `skip-today` + inventory decrement** — all added in recent sprints with zero test coverage. Nutrition meal-prep is the second priority as it involves Gemini + session state with no unit guard.
